title: Mouse holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ecb'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8226f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b01152'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9c9d8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#8d8da6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6a6a85'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='head' cx='40%' cy='30%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4d4e2'/>
      <stop offset='65%' stop-color='#9595ae'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#72728d'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='ear' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb6ad'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0655c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M62 40 Q58 55 46 62' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='27' rx='15' ry='17' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='21' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffc4dd' opacity='0.75'/>
  <path d='M65 43 L62 48 L68 48 Z' fill='#b01152'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M22 70 Q12 68 10 76 Q9 83 16 82' stroke='#c98a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='72' rx='17' ry='14' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='67' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#b8b8cc' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb6ad'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='85' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ffb6ad'/>

  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M53 62 Q60 60 62 56' stroke='#8d8da6' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='37' r='8' fill='url(#ear)'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='37' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ff8f86' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='25' r='4' fill='#e0655c'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='37' r='8' fill='url(#ear)'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='37' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#ff8f86' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='16' fill='url(#head)'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#e6e6f2' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#2a2140'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#2a2140'/>
  <circle cx='34.9' cy='41.1' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='46.9' cy='41.1' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='3.2' fill='#ff8f86'/>

  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 47 L20 44 M30 50 L20 51' stroke='#e6e6f2' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 47 L60 44 M50 50 L60 51' stroke='#e6e6f2' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
